6.q: Give the correct order of steps a state follows to implement women's reservation in the Lok Sabha under the 106th Amendment.
6.a: Implementation proceeds: (1) Wait for the next Census and Delimitation Commission report (2) Identify which specific constituencies become reserved for women (3) Apply horizontal reservation inside SC and ST reserved seats rather than overlapping separate quotas (4) Set a rotation mechanism and support elected women so proxy representation by male relatives is prevented. A wrong answer that overlays women's quotas on caste quotas as separate seats shows the student has missed the horizontal reservation principle used in Articles 243D and 330/332.
